bacterial_leaf_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked streaks starting from leaf margins turning grayish-white; bacterial ooze droplets on leaves in morning.

organic_measures.name: Fresh Cow Dung Slurry / Copper Spray
organic_measures.method: Spray 2% cow dung slurry supernatant or copper hydroxide (2 g/L) to suppress bacterial population.

chemical_measures.name: Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Drain standing water temporary if possible. Avoid excess nitrogen.

prevention_measures: Avoid heavy nitrogenous fertilizers; split N applications.
Grow resistant varieties (e.g., Improved Samba Mahsuri).
sources: ICAR - National Rice Research Institute (NRRI) Advisory
IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: Bacterial Blight

brown_spot.symptoms: Oval or sesame seed shaped brown spots with yellow halos evenly distributed on leaves and glumes.

organic_measures.name: Seed Treatment & Bio-control
organic_measures.method: Treat seeds with Trichoderma harzianum (10 g/kg seed). Apply foliar spray of Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/L).

chemical_measures.name: Mancozeb 75% WP or Edifenphos 50% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Apply during tillering and panicle initiation.

prevention_measures: Correct soil nutrient deficiencies (especially Potassium, Manganese, Silicon).
Avoid water stress during vegetative phase.

leaf_blast.symptoms: Spindle-shaped (diamond-like) lesions with grayish-white centers and reddish-brown margins on leaves.

organic_measures.name: Silicon Amendment & Bio-fungicide
organic_measures.method: Apply calcium silicate to soil. Spray Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/L) or neem oil (5 ml/L).

chemical_measures.name: Tricyclazole 75% WP or Isoprothiolane 40% EC
chemical_measures.dosage: 0.6 g / 1.5 ml per liter of water
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Spray at initial appearance of leaf blast lesions.

prevention_measures: Maintain continuous shallow flooding in paddy field.

leaf_scald.symptoms: Zonate light brown lesions starting from leaf tips/margins with alternating dark and light brown bands.

organic_measures.name: Botanical Fungicide & Balanced N
organic_measures.method: Spray Neem oil 10,000 ppm (3 ml/L) or garlic clove extract 5%.

prevention_measures: Avoid high plant density in nursery.

sheath_blight.symptoms: Oval green-gray water-soaked lesions on leaf sheaths near waterline, expanding into irregular serpentine spots.

organic_measures.name: Biological Control (Pseudomonas fluorescens)
organic_measures.method: Foliar spray and soil application of Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/L or 2.5 kg/ha in FYM).

chemical_measures.name: Validamycin 3% L or Hexaconazole 5% EC
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Direct spray towards lower leaf sheaths near water line.

prevention_measures: Remove sclerotia floating on water surface during land preparation.

healthy_rice_leaf.symptoms: Clean, erect green tillers without lesions, lesions, or insect feeding scars.

organic_measures.name: Azolla Bio-fertilizer & Zinc Application
organic_measures.method: Incorporate Azolla (500 kg/ha) into paddy soil. Apply Zinc sulphate (25 kg/ha basal).

prevention_measures: Maintain alternate wetting and drying (AWD) irrigation.
Monitor light traps for leafhopper/planthopper activity.
